summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 earnings press release and financial tables, reporting organic revenue growth of 5%, operating income growth of 23%, EPS growth of 28% supported by a share buyback program, and reaffirmed its FY 2026 outlook. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure with non-GAAP reconciliations, containing no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is an ordinary periodic report, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
